observations: Two horizontal shaft petrol engines are shown in three photos, placed on a cracked asphalt surface.
Both engines have black plastic covers, red and yellow caps, and visible signs of rust and wear, especially on the top and side components.
Photo 0 shows both engines from the front, with one having a red cap and the other a black cap on the fuel tank.
Photo 1 is a top-down view showing rust on the top covers, a metal cage over a component, and a person's feet in sandals and patterned trousers.
Photo 2 shows both engines from a side angle, with one engine's fuel tank having a blue label with white text (partially visible, unreadable).
No brand or model name is legible on any part of the engines in any photo.
The engines appear to be used, with visible corrosion and dirt.
The seller claims '10HP Petrol Engine', 'American quality', 'Strong Canadian models', and 'horizontal shaft gasoline'.
